paragraphs.text:
You  have  been  under  a  lot  of  pressure  on  this  trip.  You 
cannot say what it is about the giant ape-men that shakes 
you so deeply.

Lose  1D6  Sanity.  If  you  remain  sane,  go  to  623.  If  you  suffer 
temporary insanity, go to 646. If you suffer indefinite insanity, go 
to 364.
